title: Original-field equivariant point diagram
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, l different from its characteristic, an algebraic closure Omega of Q_l, and a finite coefficient subfield F. Put E = Coefficient(l,Omega,F), the specified Shrink model of F. Use the diagram definitions of [def-zl-point-equivariant-diagram-realization]. Given a finite category I, a diagram V of finite-dimensional E-modules and invertible operators A_i commuting with every arrow, prescribe a heart object MStar, its Weil isomorphism thetaStar and fibre identification etaStar at iStar, whose conjugated local Frobenius is A_iStar. There exist a raw constructible diagram G, heart witnesses hG, natural Weil and fibre isomorphisms theta and eta, and fibre transport isomorphisms t. The lifted heart diagram exactly realizes all relations, monomorphisms, short exact sequences and cokernel universal properties of V. Each t_i has the specified point-transport hom, and omega_E(theta_i) = t_i.inv ≫ eta_i.hom ≫ A_i.hom ≫ eta_i.inv. The object, Weil isomorphism and fibre identification at iStar equal the prescribed data, using HEq for dependent identifications. This assertion makes no coefficient-extension claim and does not assert the inverse or conjugated Frobenius formulas, which the caller derives by iso inversion and cancellation.

proof.text: Put $T=Lg_s^*$ and $\omega=\omega_E$. By [lem-zl-point-heart-finite-stage], $\omega:\Sh_c(s,E)\to\mathrm{Vect}_{E,\mathrm{fd}}$ is an exact equivalence. For each $i\ne i_*$ choose a preimage $M_i$ and an isomorphism $\eta_i:\omega M_i\cong D(i)$. At $i_*$ take literally $M_{i_*}=M_*$ and $\eta_{i_*}=\eta_*$, rather than a chosen preimage. Essential surjectivity supplies the other objects independently; fullness and faithfulness will supply all maps, so no compatibility of these choices is required. For the Shrink coefficient model, transport this exact equivalence along the canonical Shrink algebra equivalence using the specified scalar/fibre comparison; the scalar unit and inverse comparisons identify the resulting fibre with the recorded H^0 fibre functor.

source.place: Paragraph 7, dimension-zero Jordan filtration: inverse-transport lifting, Weil equivariance, exact quotients and coefficient extension; old item steps 5–6.

proof.text: Since $g_s$ is a scheme automorphism, [prop-constructible-truncations] implies $T M_i\in\Sh_c(s,E)$. Put $t_i=H^0(\iota_{M_i}):\omega M_i\to\omega(T M_i)$; it is invertible by [lem-weil-frobenius-cohomology-transport-iso](1). Write $a_i=\eta_i^{-1}A_i\eta_i$ and $b_i=a_i t_i^{-1}$. Fullness of the equivalence [lem-zl-point-heart-finite-stage] gives unique maps $\theta_i:T M_i\to M_i$ and $v_i:M_i\to T M_i$ with images $b_i$ and $t_i a_i^{-1}$. Both composites have image the identity, hence faithfulness gives $\theta_i v_i=1$ and $v_i\theta_i=1$. Thus these are actual inverse Weil maps over $E$, defining Weil sheaves by [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. The prescribed compatibility gives $\omega(\theta_*)=a_{i_*}t_{i_*}^{-1}$, so uniqueness makes $\theta_{i_*}$ literally $\theta_*$. The inverse realizes $(a_it_i^{-1})^{-1}=t_ia_i^{-1}$, with the source and target transport included.

source.place: Paragraph 7, dimension-zero Jordan filtration: inverse-transport lifting, Weil equivariance, exact quotients and coefficient extension; old item steps 5–6.

proof.text: For $u:i\to j$ put $w_u=\eta_j^{-1}D(u)\eta_i$. Fullness of [lem-zl-point-heart-finite-stage] gives a unique $f_u:M_i\to M_j$ with $\omega(f_u)=w_u$. For composable $u,v$, $w_{vu}=w_vw_u$, and $w_{1_i}=1$; faithfulness gives $f_{vu}=f_vf_u$ and $f_{1_i}=1$. The same cancellation of the intermediate $\eta$ shows that any equation between paths in $D$ holds for the $f_u$. In particular the underlying diagram and all its relations are realized without modifying $M_*$ or $\eta_*$ on arrows incident with $i_*$.

source.place: Paragraph 7, dimension-zero Jordan filtration: inverse-transport lifting, Weil equivariance, exact quotients and coefficient extension; old item steps 5–6.

proof.text:
By [lem-weil-frobenius-point-transport-natural](2), $\omega(Tf_u)t_i=t_jw_u$. The given equivariance says $w_ua_i=a_jw_u$. Consequently
$$\omega(f_u\theta_i)=w_ua_it_i^{-1}=a_jw_ut_i^{-1}=a_jt_j^{-1}\omega(Tf_u)=\omega(\theta_jTf_u).$$
Faithfulness in [lem-zl-point-heart-finite-stage] gives $f_u\theta_i=\theta_jTf_u$, exactly the morphism condition of [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. Thus the lifted diagram is a diagram of Weil sheaves, not merely a diagram in the underlying heart.

source.place: Paragraph 7, dimension-zero Jordan filtration: inverse-transport lifting, Weil equivariance, exact quotients and coefficient extension; old item steps 5–6.

proof.text: The fibre isomorphisms $\eta_i$ identify the underlying lifted diagram with $D$. Hence every designated short exact sequence, monomorphism, and cokernel diagram in $D$ is realized in the heart: [lem-zl-point-heart-finite-stage] explicitly preserves and reflects kernels, cokernels, zero objects and short exact sequences. For a cokernel this includes its universal property, not just the vanishing of the composite; comparison with any other cokernel in the heart is its unique isomorphism commuting with the quotient map. All maps in such diagrams are Weil morphisms by the preceding calculation.
